Method.Implementation:
Write "<script type=""text/javascript"">",! Write "document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {",! Write " if (typeof DashboardFramework === 'undefined') {",! Write " console.error('DashboardFramework not loaded');",! Write " return;",! Write " }",! Write " try {",!
Write " DashboardFramework.clear();",! Write " DashboardFramework.init();",!
Set tGenderRatio = $G(pMetrics("GenderRatio"), "N/A") Set tTopProgram = $G(pMetrics("topProgram"), "N/A")
Write " DashboardFramework.addMetric({title:'Total Patients',value:",($G(pMetrics("TotalPatients"), 0)),",icon:'👥'});",! Write " DashboardFramework.addMetric({title:'Active Programs',value:",($G(pMetrics("ActivePrograms"), 0)),",icon:'📋'});",! Write " DashboardFramework.addMetric({title:'Average Age',value:",($G(pMetrics("AvgAge"), 0)),",icon:'🎂'});",! Write " DashboardFramework.addMetric({title:'Gender Ratio (M:F)',value:'",$ZCVT(tGenderRatio,"O","JS"),"',icon:'⚖️'});",!
If pHasFilters =3 { Kill tChartData Do ##class(PCS.Riayati.HSCUSTOM.Util.ChartsDataConverter).ConvertEnrollmentTrendToChart(.pTrendData, 90, .tChartData) Set tLabels = $G(tChartData("labels"), "") Set tValues = $G(tChartData("values"), "") If tLabels '= "" {
Set tBarChartName = "Enrollment Trend - Last 90 Days (Bar)" Write " DashboardFramework.addChart({name:'",$ZCVT(tBarChartName,"O","JS"),"',type:'bar',labels:[",tLabels,"],values:[",tValues,"]});",!
Set tLineChartName = "Enrollment Trend - Last 90 Days (Line)" Write " DashboardFramework.addChart({name:'",$ZCVT(tLineChartName,"O","JS"),"',type:'line',labels:[",tLabels,"],values:[",tValues,"]});",! } } Else { Write " console.log('No filters applied - Trend Charts will not not be shown');",! } Write " UISwap.ready()",! Write " DashboardFramework.render();",!
Write " } catch (ex) {",! Write " console.error('Dashboard initialization error:', ex);",! Write " }",! Write "});",! Write "</script>",!

Method.name: UpdateDashboardTab
Method.Implementation:
Set tResult = {} Set ^yO(1)=pSearchParamsArr Set tFiltersObj = ##class(%DynamicObject).%FromJSON(pSearchParamsArr) Set tFilters("ProgramId") = tFiltersObj.ProgramId Set tFilters("MPIID") = tFiltersObj.MPIID Set tFilters("FromTime") = tFiltersObj.FromTime Set tFilters("MRN") = tFiltersObj.MRN Set tFilters("AssigningAuthority") = tFiltersObj.AssigningAuthority M ^yO(2)=tFilters Kill tMetrics, tTrendData Do ##class(PCS.UI.Cohorts.Util.DiseaseRegistryMetrics).GetDashboardMetrics(.tFilters, .tMetrics) Do ##class(PCS.UI.Cohorts.Util.DiseaseRegistryMetrics).GetEnrollmentTrend(.tFilters, .tTrendData) M ^yO(3)=tMetrics M ^yO(4)=tTrendData Set tResult.TotalPatients = $G(tMetrics("TotalPatients"), 0) Set tResult.AvgAge = $G(tMetrics("AvgAge"), 0) Set tResult.GenderRatio = $G(tMetrics("GenderRatio"), "N/A")
Kill tChartData Do ##class(PCS.Riayati.HSCUSTOM.Util.ChartsDataConverter).ConvertEnrollmentTrendToChart(.tTrendData, 90, .tChartData) Set tResult.chartLabels = $G(tChartData("labels"), "") Set tResult.chartValues = $G(tChartData("values"), "") M ^yO(5)= tResult Quit tResult.%ToJSON()
